mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level is associated with a higher probability of positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for equity valuation.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production and housing starts signals robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to strengthened consumer and business confidence.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the annual change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals an inflationary environment that triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that lowers corporate profit forecasts, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A recent increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.25% within the past month signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales exceed 360,000 million dollars, it indicates strong consumer spending that boosts corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day SPX returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 360,000 million.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate combined with a declining unemployment rate signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of positive GDPC1 growth and falling UNRATE fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.
